description: Built a ROS2 path-planning module for autonomous surface vessels.
highlights: Combined the Hybrid A* algorithm with an Artificial Potential Field (APF) post-optimizer to generate non-holonomic paths.
Implemented the constrained APF optimizer in modern C++ with NLopt, enforcing collision-free corridor and curvature constraints.
Validated the system in 1 km² simulated maritime environments, achieving 20 m path precision with optimization completing in 1 second per run.
